blocking_conditions: The EPA individual NPDES table is not a complete sanitary-operator census; known current PDMU and LRA systems are independently documented outside it.
Several EPA-listed non-AAA sanitary permits are past nominal expiration and current operating/continuation status is not uniformly resolved.
DRNA/OGPe/PRASA project records document systems in transition to PRASA and must not be double-counted across pre/post-transfer states.
Punta Picuas proves non-franchised private decentralized systems exist outside the three private utility franchises, while its legal operator and station count remain unresolved.
The 91-row 2015 non-AAA En Uso seed is historical and lacks complete current continuity adjudication.
